{{Top|leg}}
'''Guild Enforcers''' were a paramilitary group under authority of the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]].

During a plot by [[Figg Excavations/Legends|Figg Excavations]] to cut its ties with the Mining Guild, a team of Enforcers was sent to [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] to investigate.
